newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian share index steady in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian share index steady in active trade.

text.p: Share price rises due to favourable company results were balanced by falls at several highly capitalised companies, leaving the all-share index barely moved in active trade on Monday.
The all-share index closed at 6501.88 from 6,501.89 on Friday. Traders rewarded a good Nestle Foods half-year result with the maximum five percent increase of 1.45 naira to close at 30.50 naira.
Construction firm G. Cappa gained 25 kobo to end at 7.75 naira after posting increased full year profits.
Local Coca-Cola bottler, Nigerian Bottling Co, rose 13 kobo to 28.72 naira after its own half year results.
African Petroleum closed 60 kobo higher at 31.20 naira.
Insurance firm AIICO gained 20 kobo to 6.70 naira.
Lever Brothers fell five kobo to 25.70 naira -- traders said an institutional investor was profit-taking and got rid of a large number of shares.
United Bank for Africa dropped 10 kobo to 5.20 naira.

Guinness fell five kobo to 8.90 naira, while International Breweries dropped three to 67 kobo. Tyre maker Dunlop slid 10 kobo to 12.10 naira. First Aluminium was down 20 kobo at 4.90 naira. ($1=80 naira)
